module_summary: AXI-Stream-to-GMII/MII transmitter: a 7-state FSM emits preamble/SFD, payload, padding and byte-serialised CRC32 FCS, then IFG; MII mode splits bytes into nibbles.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/PREAMBLE/PAYLOAD/LAST/PAD/FCS/IFG controller selecting GMII output and tready

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: AXI-Stream input byte loaded into s_tdata_reg

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input valid; starts frame and detects underflow

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready driven by FSM

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker moving FSM to LAST

anchors.name: s_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Bit0 marks frame error forcing tx_er; PTP tag source

anchors.name: gmii_txd
anchors.why: GMII transmit byte/nibble output

anchors.name: gmii_tx_en
anchors.why: GMII transmit enable during frame

anchors.name: gmii_tx_er
anchors.why: GMII transmit error asserted on errored frame FCS

anchors.name: gmii_txd_next
anchors.why: FSM-selected output byte: preamble, SFD, payload, pad, FCS

anchors.name: s_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Payload byte register feeding GMII output and CRC LFSR

anchors.name: crc_state
anchors.why: Running CRC32; bytes serialised out in FCS state

anchors.name: reset_crc
anchors.why: Reinitialises CRC in IDLE/PREAMBLE

anchors.name: update_crc
anchors.why: Advances CRC during payload and padding

anchors.name: frame_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Counts preamble bytes, FCS byte index and IFG cycles

anchors.name: frame_min_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining bytes to minimum length; drives PAD state

anchors.name: mii_odd_reg
anchors.why: MII nibble phase; holds FSM and outputs high nibble on odd cycles

anchors.name: mii_msn_reg
anchors.why: Holds high nibble for second MII cycle

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: Inside-frame flag for dropping rest of frame and holding IFG

anchors.name: frame_error_reg
anchors.why: Latched frame error driving gmii_tx_er during FCS

anchors.name: clk_enable
anchors.why: Clock enable holding FSM and outputs when low

anchors.name: mii_select
anchors.why: Selects MII nibble mode versus GMII byte mode

anchors.name: cfg_ifg
anchors.why: Configured inter-frame gap length

anchors.name: cfg_tx_enable
anchors.why: Transmit enable gating frame start

anchors.name: error_underflow
anchors.why: Pulse when tvalid drops mid-frame

anchors.name: start_packet
anchors.why: Start-of-frame pulse after SFD

anchors.name: start_packet_reg
anchors.why: Start pulse triggering PTP timestamp and tag capture

anchors.name: m_axis_ptp_ts
anchors.why: Captured transmit timestamp output

anchors.name: m_axis_ptp_ts_valid
anchors.why: Valid pulse for timestamp and tag

groups.name: TX FSM
groups.description: Sequences preamble, payload, pad, FCS and IFG emission

groups.name: Frame counters
groups.description: Preamble/FCS/IFG byte pointer and minimum-length pad counter

groups.name: MII nibble adapter
groups.description: Splits bytes into two MII nibbles under clock enable

groups.name: GMII output
groups.description: Registered GMII data, enable and error outputs

groups.name: PTP and status
groups.description: Start-of-frame timestamp capture and status pulses
